title: Alaska
autoCompleteNotReady: Available once every card is face up
hintToAria: Hint: destination for the hinted card

frontendHint.moveToFoundation: A card can be moved to the foundation
frontendHint.moveToTableau: A card can be moved between tableau columns

tutorial.foundation: Build up cards A→K by suit here.
tutorial.tableau: Cards are dealt here. Click or drag face-up cards. Tableau-to-tableau moves require the SAME suit but may build up or down, and an empty column accepts any card.
tutorial.controls: Action buttons: hint, give up, undo.

tableauRule: Tableau moves must be the same suit, one rank up OR down — unlike Yukon, alternating colours will not connect, but Alaska builds in both directions. Any card may go to an empty column. Face-down cards can't be moved.
faceDownRule: Face-down cards can't be moved — only face-up cards are playable
faceDownCardLabel: Column {{col}}, card {{pos}} from top, face down
blockMoveLabel: moves as a block of {{n}} cards
